01 · The files

Two formats,
the same 783 words

Both files hold the TOPIK I Beginner 1 list exactly as it is on this site: 783 words, each with its romanization, an English meaning and a real example sentence with its own reading and translation. The Anki deck is for spaced repetition on any device; the PDF is for printing or reading offline.

Anki deck · .apkg

TOPIK I Beginner 1 for Anki

One note per word, two cards each: recognition (hangul on the front) and recall (meaning on the front). Every card shows the example sentence on the back, and the notes are tagged by level. Re-importing a newer deck updates your cards instead of duplicating them.

03 · Importing

Into Anki
in a minute

  1. Get Anki. Anki is free on desktop (ankiweb.net) and Android (AnkiDroid); the iPhone app, AnkiMobile, is a paid one-time purchase from the same team.
  2. Open the file. On desktop, File → Import and pick the .apkg, or double-click it. On AnkiDroid, open the file from your downloads. On AnkiMobile, share the file to Anki.
  3. Study. The deck appears as "Lock&Learn Korean::TOPIK I". Its cards ask the hangul with its romanization for the meaning, and the meaning for the hangul, and show its romanization, the meaning and the example sentence with its reading and translation on the back.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

Is this the whole TOPIK I list?

It is the Beginner 1 half of the TOPIK I list, 783 words, which is the free pack in Lock&Learn Korean and the part of the list this site publishes with example sentences. The other half is on the TOPIK I list page and in the app.

Can I use these files freely?

For your own study, yes, on as many devices as you like. The word list and glosses carry their sources' licenses (see the attribution on the list page); the example sentences are Lock&Learn's own. Please do not republish the files or bundle them into another product.

Do I need Anki for the deck?

Yes. The .apkg format is Anki's package format and opens in Anki on desktop, AnkiDroid and AnkiMobile. If you do not use Anki, the PDF holds the same words, or read the list on this site where Flashcards mode hides the meanings for you.

Will the files be updated?

When the TOPIK I list changes on this site, the files are rebuilt with it. Re-download and import the deck again: the cards keep their review history because every note has a stable id.

Is Lock&Learn Korean free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: Beginner 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
